ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; predominantly high-intensity white pixels (>80%) occupying central lobe regions contrasted against low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones across the central lobes; bounded by an irregular, low-intensity black trailing edge and concentrated dark pigmentation clusters at both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, obtuse V-shaped central depression with an estimated angle of 150-160 degrees and shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serrations consisting of jagged peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3-12 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering with an upward vertical sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark, high-contrast mottled pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned light-gray linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the white ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and jagged erosion along the entirety of the trailing edge, suggesting cumulative physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible specular highlights and pixel glare along the leading edge midline caused by the water-air interface.
